steps.anchor: ① 观察：记住方块点亮顺序
steps.enAnchor: ① Observe: Memorize lighting order

steps.anchor: 系统会显示要找的物品名称
steps.enAnchor: The system shows the target object name

steps.anchor: 认识目标值
steps.enAnchor: Step 1: Know the Target

steps.anchor: 选择卡片
steps.enAnchor: Step 2: Select Cards

steps.anchor: 卡片消失与刷新
steps.enAnchor: Step 3: Cards Disappear & Refresh

steps.anchor: 智能难度调整
steps.enAnchor: Step 4: Smart Difficulty Adjustment

steps.anchor: 系统会显示需要购买的商品名称，请仔细记住它们！
steps.enAnchor: The system will display the items you need to buy. Remember them!

steps.anchor: 从货架上找到并选择所需商品，注意记住价格！
steps.enAnchor: Find and select the required items from the shelf. Remember the prices!

steps.anchor: 记住商品价格，计算总价，然后从4个选项中选择正确答案
steps.enAnchor: Remember item prices, calculate the total, then choose the correct answer from 4 options

steps.anchor: 屏幕上会出现许多带有数字和字母的气泡，你需要根据屏幕顶部显示的题目要求，刺破指定的气泡。
steps.enAnchor: Bubbles with numbers and letters will float up on screen. Pop the correct bubbles according to the task shown at the top.

steps.anchor: 点击正确的气泡即可将其刺破并获得分数。点击错误的气泡不会有任何反应，请仔细辨别！
steps.enAnchor: Tap the correct bubble to pop it and earn points. Tapping a wrong bubble has no effect — be precise!

steps.anchor: 屏幕中央会出现一个颜色词（红/绿/蓝/黄），请判断文字的字体颜色（而非文字含义），并点击下方对应的颜色按钮。
steps.enAnchor: A color word (Red/Green/Blue/Yellow) will appear on screen. Select the FONT COLOR of the word (not its meaning) by clicking the correct button below.

steps.anchor: 屏幕中间会显示4~5张参考卡片，屏幕下方有一张目标卡片。根据顶部显示的规则（颜色 / 数量 / 形状），从参考卡片中选出与目标卡片相匹配的一张。
steps.enAnchor: 4–5 reference cards appear in the center. A target card appears at the bottom. Based on the rule shown at the top (Color / Quantity / Shape), click the reference card that matches the target.

steps.anchor: 请按照数字出现的顺序依次输入
steps.enAnchor: Enter digits in the order they appeared

steps.anchor: 请按照数字出现的逆序依次输入
steps.enAnchor: Enter digits in reverse order

steps.anchor: 路径消失后，点击格子来重现路径（蓝色高亮引导）。
steps.enAnchor: After path fades, click cells to retrace it (blue = your path).

steps.anchor: 看图片，选择正确的类别
steps.enAnchor: Look at the image and select the correct category

steps.anchor: 找出与其他3个不同的那一个，点击它
steps.enAnchor: Find the item that is different from the other 3 and click it

steps.anchor: 用铲子点击化石消失的位置
steps.enAnchor: Click where the fossils disappeared!

steps.anchor: 4张图中有1张与其他不同，点击找出它！
steps.enAnchor: 1 of 4 images differs — tap to find it!

steps.anchor: 答对得分！难度自动调整
steps.enAnchor: Correct = score! Difficulty auto-adjusts

steps.anchor: 不同种类+翻转
steps.enAnchor: Different type + flipped

steps.anchor: 判断该面孔是否出现过
steps.enAnchor: Judge if this face appeared

steps.anchor: 先点击左侧一张图片（高亮选中）
steps.enAnchor: Click a left image to select it

steps.anchor: 再点击右侧关联图片完成配对
steps.enAnchor: Click the matching right image to pair

steps.anchor: 屏幕下方显示目标物
steps.enAnchor: Target shown at bottom

steps.anchor: 点击与目标物相同的物品
steps.enAnchor: Click items matching the target

steps.anchor: 小鱼出现，记住它们身上的数字！
steps.enAnchor: Fish appear with numbers — memorize them!

steps.anchor: 数字隐藏了，凭记忆找到顺序！
steps.enAnchor: Numbers are hidden — remember the order!

steps.anchor: 按数字从小到大依次点击小鱼！
steps.enAnchor: Click fish from smallest to largest number!

steps.anchor: 屏幕上显示物体图片
steps.enAnchor: Object images appear on screen

steps.anchor: 挂锁上有形状镂空的锁孔，选择钥匙齿板形状与锁孔一致的那把
steps.enAnchor: The padlock has shape keyholes. Pick the key whose bit shape matches.

steps.anchor: 观察左侧目标积木的形状
steps.enAnchor: Observe the target shape on the left

steps.anchor: 选择数量最多的一项！
steps.enAnchor: Choose the item with the most!

steps.anchor: ② 按顺序点击词语放入句子带
steps.enAnchor: ② Tap words one by one to fill the belt

steps.anchor: 点击顾客点过的所有菜品（顺序不限）
steps.enAnchor: Click all dishes (order not required)

steps.anchor: 步骤 1：仔细观察并记忆卡牌图案及位置
steps.enAnchor: Step 1: Watch and memorize the cards and their positions.

steps.anchor: 步骤 2：卡牌翻回背面，凭记忆点击两张相同图案的卡牌
steps.enAnchor: Step 2: Cards flip back. Click two cards with the same image.

steps.anchor: 第一步：记住黑羊的位置（3 秒）
steps.enAnchor: Step 1: Memorize the black sheep positions (3s)

steps.anchor: 第二步：羊群消失后，点击黑羊所在的位置
steps.enAnchor: Step 2: After the sheep disappear, click where the black sheep were

steps.anchor: 系统会显示购物清单里的物品，请仔细记住！
steps.enAnchor: The system shows the shopping list. Remember all the items!

steps.anchor: 点击物品也可放入购物车，再次点击可取消
steps.enAnchor:
💡
Clicking an item also adds it; click again to remove

steps.anchor: 选完全部物品后点击"确认购物"或等待时间结束
steps.enAnchor: When done, click "Confirm" or wait for time to run out

steps.anchor: 第一步：屏幕会展示一张面孔，请仔细观察面部情绪
steps.enAnchor: Step 1: A face will appear. Watch its expression carefully.

steps.anchor: 第三步：从下方选项中选择正确的情绪
steps.enAnchor: Step 3: Choose the correct emotion from the options.

steps.anchor: 选择正确将得到分数，让我们开始训练吧！
steps.enAnchor: A correct answer earns points. Let's begin!

steps.anchor: 屏幕上会出现要购票的人群和票价
steps.enAnchor: People to buy tickets appear on screen with their prices

steps.anchor: 根据题目要求计算总价
steps.enAnchor: Calculate the total according to the question

steps.anchor: 在下方选项中选择正确答案
steps.enAnchor: Choose the correct answer from options below

steps.anchor: 仔细听广播播报的数字，按听到的顺序依次输入
steps.enAnchor: Listen carefully to the broadcast, then enter the digits in the same order

steps.anchor: 仔细听广播播报的数字，按听到的逆序依次输入
steps.enAnchor: Listen carefully to the broadcast, then enter the digits in reverse order

steps.anchor: 第一步：观察花园中的小狗
steps.enAnchor: Step 1: Watch the garden dogs

steps.anchor: 点击相邻方格移动货车，规划最短路线
steps.enAnchor: Click adjacent cells to move. Plan shortest route.

steps.anchor: 使用键盘 ← ↑ → 键，或点击屏幕下方按钮切换赛道。
steps.enAnchor: Use ← ↑ → keys or tap the buttons at the bottom of the screen.

steps.anchor: 第一步：米字格中会出现一个黑色汉字，请集中注意力记住它。
steps.enAnchor: Step 1: A black Chinese character appears in the grid — memorize it.

steps.anchor: 第三步：屏幕两侧会出现候选偏旁，请把正确的偏旁拖到米字格里。
steps.enAnchor: Step 3: Candidate radicals appear on both sides. Drag the correct ones onto the grid.

steps.anchor: 屏幕中会出现彩色靶心，请注意目标颜色。
steps.enAnchor: Colored targets appear on screen. Note the required color.

steps.anchor: 点击对应颜色的靶心即可完成打击。
steps.enAnchor: Click the matching target to score a hit.

steps.anchor: 平板端请直接触摸左右两侧
steps.enAnchor: On tablet, tap the left/right side of screen

steps.anchor: 进入房间，仔细观察被高亮的物品，记住它的位置、颜色和数量。
steps.enAnchor: Enter the room and observe the highlighted items. Remember their color, position and count.

steps.anchor: 倒计时结束后，房间将会消失，屏幕将出现题目。
steps.enAnchor: When countdown ends, the room disappears and a question appears.

steps.anchor: 第一步：观察厨房，找到闪烁高亮的安全隐患。
steps.enAnchor: Step 1: Observe the kitchen and find the blinking hazards.

steps.anchor: 第二步：直接点击隐患位置进行识别。
steps.enAnchor: Step 2: Tap directly on the hazard to identify it.

steps.anchor: 用鼠标点击红色陨石即可摧毁它。
steps.enAnchor: Click on a red asteroid to destroy it.

steps.anchor: 灰色陨石是友好的，请勿点击它！
steps.enAnchor: Gray asteroids are friendly — do NOT click them!

steps.anchor: 这位客人是什么表情？
steps.enAnchor: What's this customer's emotion?

steps.anchor: 点击你认为正确的选项
steps.enAnchor: Tap the correct option

steps.anchor: 答对了！获得分数。
steps.enAnchor: Correct! You get points.

steps.anchor: 答错则不得分，继续下一位客人。
steps.enAnchor: Wrong answers get no points. Next customer.

steps.anchor: 第二步：记住敲击的顺序和音调
steps.enAnchor: Step 2: Remember the tapping order and pitches

steps.anchor: 第三步：按相同顺序点击瓶子复现旋律
steps.enAnchor: Step 3: Click the bottles in the same order

steps.anchor: 高等难度：点击非三角形中的数字
steps.enAnchor:
Hard: tap numbers NOT inside a triangle
Skip the triangles

steps.anchor: ① 观察场景中的物品与虚拟人物的所在位置。
steps.enAnchor: ① Observe the table and the positions of the virtual characters.

steps.anchor: ② 阅读题目：请以指定人物的视角判断物品的方向。
steps.enAnchor: ② Read the question — take the perspective of the specified character.

steps.anchor: ③ 从四个方向选项中选择正确答案。
steps.enAnchor: ③ Choose the correct direction from the four options.

steps.anchor: 课堂上，老师会依次朗读一组词语，请仔细聆听。
steps.enAnchor: The teacher reads a sequence of words aloud. Listen carefully.

steps.anchor: 按照老师朗读的先后顺序，牢牢记住每一个词。
steps.enAnchor: Memorize both the words and their order.

steps.anchor: 在下方按钮中，按老师的朗读顺序依次点击相同词语。
steps.enAnchor: Tap the buttons below in the exact order they were spoken.

steps.anchor: 观察上方规则屏，明确本题的分类要求。
steps.enAnchor: Read the rule board to know the current sorting requirement.

steps.anchor: 请将绿色放入对应分类桶
steps.enAnchor: Sort Green into the right bin

steps.anchor: 👆 从下方选项中选择正确数字
steps.enAnchor: 👆 Pick the correct number from options below

steps.anchor: 虫子会从四周爬向花朵，鼠标点击将其消灭，每只 +5 分。
steps.enAnchor: Bugs crawl toward the flower. Click to squash them. +5 points each.

steps.anchor: 周边树木会随机起火，点击火焰将其扑灭，每处 +10 分。
steps.enAnchor: Trees around the flower may catch fire. Click to put them out. +10 points each.

steps.anchor: 仔细观察 A 侧亮点位置，闪烁位置就是应该在 B 侧选择的答案。
steps.enAnchor: Watch the highlighted cell on A. The blinking cell on B shows the correct answer.

steps.anchor: 仔细记住人物的姓名、年龄、性别、职业等信息。
steps.enAnchor: Remember the name, age, gender, occupation and other info.

steps.anchor: 第一步：观察展示的图片碎片，记住它的花纹或颜色特征。
steps.enAnchor: Step 1: observe the fragment and remember its pattern.

steps.anchor: 第二步：屏幕会出现蝴蝶，点击蝴蝶完成干扰任务。
steps.enAnchor: Step 2: butterflies appear — click them (distraction).

steps.anchor: 第三步：从若干张完整图片中选择与碎片对应的那一张。
steps.enAnchor: Step 3: pick the full image that contains the fragment.

steps.anchor: 观察题目要求的目标时间，如 3:00
steps.enAnchor: Read the target time first, e.g. 3:00

steps.anchor: 按住时针或分针，直接拖动它们旋转
steps.enAnchor: Press and drag the hour or minute hand

steps.anchor: 把指针拖到目标位置，然后点击"提交答案"
steps.enAnchor: Align to target, then press Submit

steps.anchor: 高难度下容错范围极小，请精准对位！
steps.enAnchor: High level = tiny tolerance. Be precise!

steps.anchor: 游戏中，请从四个选项中选出正确的展开图案。
steps.enAnchor: In the game, choose the correct unfolded pattern from four options.

steps.anchor: 游戏开始后左右两侧会呈现一组物体，其中有若干处不同。仔细比对每一个细节。
steps.enAnchor: Two similar scenes appear side by side with several small differences. Compare every detail carefully.

steps.anchor: 发现不同后，直接在任意一侧点击该物体。命中会显示绿色对勾并加分。
steps.enAnchor: When you spot a difference, click directly on it on either side. A green check appears and points are added.

steps.anchor: 点错位置会震动提示，并扣除 2 秒回合时间；超时未完成会显示未找到的位置。
steps.enAnchor: Wrong clicks shake the frame and cost 2 seconds. If the timer runs out, unfound spots are revealed.

steps.anchor: 进入房间，仔细观察被高亮的物品位于房间的哪个位置区。
steps.enAnchor: Look at which area of the room the highlighted items are in.

steps.anchor: 请回忆刚才花瓶出现的位置？
steps.enAnchor: Where did the vase appear?

steps.anchor: 用鼠标或手指拖动下方的收集器，去接住开心的星星。
steps.enAnchor: Use your mouse or finger to drag the basket to catch happy stars.

steps.anchor: 第一步：观察厨房场景，识别出现的安全隐患。
steps.enAnchor: Step 1: Observe the kitchen and identify the hazard.

steps.anchor: 请选择正确的处理方式
steps.enAnchor: Pick the correct response

steps.anchor: ② 观察中间的图片，思考它们的正确顺序
steps.enAnchor: ② Look at the images in the middle and think about the correct order

steps.anchor: 示例1：全脸出现，从 3 个情绪选项中选择正确的一项。
steps.enAnchor: Ex.1: Full face shown, choose the correct emotion from 3 options.

steps.anchor: 示例2：下半张脸被遮挡，观察上半张脸和眼睛判断情绪。
steps.enAnchor: Ex.2: Lower face covered, rely on the upper face and eyes.

steps.anchor: 示例3：仅显示眼睛区域，靠眼神判断情绪，红色为错误，绿色为正确。
steps.enAnchor: Ex.3: Only eyes shown. Green = correct, red = wrong.
